solutionSql:
SELECT c.id, c.name
FROM customers AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM shipments AS s
  WHERE s.customer_id = c.id
    AND s.booked_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-22 00:00:00+00'
)
ORDER BY c.id;

ambiguities.phrase: no shipment booked on or after 22 January 2026 (UTC)
ambiguities.readingChosen: Open-ended cutoff: any booking at or after 2026-01-22 00:00:00 UTC, with no upper bound, makes a customer active; cutoff written as an explicit UTC timestamptz so the session time zone does not matter.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Only bookings between the cutoff and some reporting date (e.g. today) count; or the cutoff is compared after casting booked_at to a date in the session time zone rather than UTC.

notes: Anti-join with NOT EXISTS so customers with no shipments at all are kept. The cutoff is inclusive (>= midnight UTC 22 Jan), so a booking at exactly 00:00 UTC that day counts as recent. Earlier bookings are ignored. Sample: customers 1 and 2 have bookings on 31 Jan and are excluded; 3-6 last booked 16 Jan; 7 and 8 never booked.
